about: Prima serie di clip per il companion, generata con npm run kimodo -- --series scripts/kimodo-series.json --out <cartella>. Ogni voce e' una richiesta a Kimodo: una clip sola, o una sequenza (entrata, ciclo, uscita) generata in un colpo solo e tagliata, cosi' le fasi si raccordano. Seduto sul bordo = seduto su una sedia: Kimodo non vede il bordo, ma la posa (cosce orizzontali, gambe giu') e' la stessa. In braccio = in punta di piedi con le braccia in alto: Kimodo non solleva il corpo da terra (sollevato si accovaccia, fluttuare lo sdraia). loop: il tratto che si ripete meglio viene tagliato e chiuso. Vedi docs/kimodo-prompts.md.

clips.prompt: A person stands relaxed, breathing slowly, shifting weight slightly from one foot to the other, arms loose at the sides.
A person stands still and looks around curiously to the left and to the right, then back to the front.
A person stands with hands clasped behind the back, rocking gently on the heels.
A person raises both arms above the head and stretches, leaning back a little, then lowers the arms.
A person yawns, covering the mouth with the right hand, then lowers the hand.

sequence.prompt: A person slowly sits down on the floor and hugs their knees.
A person sits on the floor hugging their knees, breathing slowly and swaying slightly.
A person sitting on the floor hugging their knees stands up.
A person sits down on a chair, hands resting on the thighs.
A person sits on a chair, relaxed, gently swinging the lower legs back and forth.
A person sitting on a chair stands up.

clips.prompt: A person stands on tiptoe with both arms raised overhead, legs relaxed, swaying gently.
A person waves hello with the right hand, smiling.
A person jumps slightly and raises both fists happily.
A person puts a hand on the chin and thinks, tilting the head.
A person stands dozing off, head slowly dropping forward and jerking back up.
A person walks forward at a relaxed pace.
A person dances happily, bouncing to the beat and swinging the arms.
A person does a slow, relaxed sway dance.
